name: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport

runway.v: two runways: 17R/35L 3,800 m × 45 m and 17L/35R 3,750 m × 55 m, asphalt

hours.v: aerodrome operator H24 and ATS H24

permits.v: crew must request customs entry control and immigration inspection 2 hours before the flight or arrival; aircraft operators must tell SAG (agriculture and health service) 12 hours before arrival
permits.quote: Crew must request entry control service 02 hours prior to flight or arrival

handling.v: handling on request to the handling companies
handling.quote: Upon request to the Handling Companies

noise.v: AD 2.21: runway 17R/35L restricted 00:00-06:00 local, except ICAO Annex 16 Chapter 14 aircraft, landings without reverse thrust and runway use needed for safety; Chapter 3 aircraft may not take off 22:00-07:00 local (both runways)
noise.quote: El uso de la pista estará restringido para su operación entre las 00:00 y 06:00 HL.

ppr.v: every non-scheduled aircraft carrying passengers must coordinate parking with the airport concession, Consorcio Nuevo Pudahuel, before the flight starts
ppr.quote: deberá coordinar estacionamiento con el Consorcio Nuevo Pudahuel

missing: curfew (AD 2.21 restricts one runway and Chapter 3 departures at night, recorded under noise; no airport-wide night ban stated)
notes: Source: AIP Chile Vol I AD 2 SCEL (DGAC), pages dated 15 MAY 2025 (AMDT 63) to 06 AUG 2026 (AMDT 67); DGAC IFIS page for SCEL also read (runway RWY H24, ATS 0000-2359 daily). AD 2.20: aircraft of 25,000 kg or more may not make 180° turns on the runway.
